Put one warrior in every clearing except the diagonally opposite corner. Place one sawmill, workshop and recruiter among the keep clearing and adjacent clearings, in any combination respecting slots. Put the remaining five buildings of each type on their tracks from right to left, leaving leftmost space empty.

answer.ruling: Supply 25 Marquise warriors and 8 wood. Put the Keep in any corner clearing. Place one warrior in every clearing except the diagonally opposite corner.

Place one sawmill, one workshop, and one recruiter among the Keep clearing and adjacent clearings, in any combination that respects building slots. Put the remaining five buildings of each type on their tracks from right to left, leaving each track’s leftmost space empty.
